description: Defines classes for tracking instances, copies, moves, swaps, and comparisons of objects used in tests within the Abseil library. Includes classes for different move/copy capabilities and an internal tracker for counting operations.

classes.name: BaseCountedInstance
classes.description: A class that counts occurrences, copies, moves, swaps, and comparisons of instances for testing purposes.

classes.name: InstanceTracker
classes.description: A helper class to track the number of instances, copies, moves, swaps, and comparisons of BaseCountedInstance objects during tests.

classes.name: CopyableOnlyInstance
classes.description: A subclass of BaseCountedInstance that supports copying but not moving.

classes.name: CopyableMovableInstance
classes.description: A subclass of BaseCountedInstance that supports both copying and moving.

classes.name: MovableOnlyInstance
classes.description: A subclass of BaseCountedInstance that supports moving but not copying.
